commands.root_examples:
Stable scripting:
  spaceprune scan [--module <id>] [--selector <id>...] [--task <id>...]
  spaceprune clean --yes [--module <id>] [--selector <id>...] [--task <id>...]

Management:
  spaceprune authorization <status|install>
  spaceprune module list [--all]
  spaceprune plugin <catalog|list|inspect|install|remove|enable|disable>
  spaceprune automation <list|install|uninstall|run>
  spaceprune recipe [list|set <recipe-id>]
  spaceprune theme [list|set <theme-id>]
  spaceprune language [list|set <system|en|zh-CN>]

稳定脚本接口：
  spaceprune scan [--module <id>] [--selector <id>...] [--task <id>...]
  spaceprune clean --yes [--module <id>] [--selector <id>...] [--task <id>...]

管理命令：
  spaceprune authorization <status|install>
  spaceprune module list [--all]
  spaceprune plugin <catalog|list|inspect|install|remove|enable|disable>
  spaceprune automation <list|install|uninstall|run>
  spaceprune recipe [list|set <recipe-id>]
  spaceprune theme [list|set <theme-id>]
  spaceprune language [list|set <system|en|zh-CN>]
